column1: # Phase 5e derived legacy artifact diff contract.

# rows below. verifyPhase5eDerivedLegacyWar proves every other entry is
# byte-identical, recomputes both replaced descriptors from the frozen text plus
# and derived-zk-xml-insert.xml, and inspects the overlay jar's class list.
# Digests are deliberately NOT pinned here. The overlay jar is compiled output:
# pinning its bytes would make every ordinary source change a contract edit, and
# a contract that is edited on every change stops being reviewed. What IS pinned
# is the shape of the difference - which entries may differ, and how - plus the
# recomputed descriptor text and the overlay's package closure.
